run_single_point_orca: run a single-point ORCA energy and gradient calculation on an Atoms object with a given functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run an ORCA geometry optimization on an Atoms object using the ase_relaxation recipe with custom optimizer parameters
run_orca_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled via the nbo flag
run_orca_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using the Vertical.MetalOrganics setting
run_orca_parallel: run an ORCA single-point calculation parallelized across multiple CPU cores using the nprocs parameter
